say:1:1029401001:1.text: Ahem! Temesia, you're a witness of what happened. I, Detective Fay, will question you today.
say:1:1029401001:1.source_cn: 咳咳，证人圣骑士特弥希娅，菲侦探今天要对你进行质询。

say:2:1029401002:1.text: What do you want to know?
say:2:1029401002:1.source_cn: 那么，你们想知道什么呢？

choice_prompt:3:1029401002.text: What do you want to know?
choice_prompt:3:1029401002.source_cn: 那么，你们想知道什么呢？

say:4:1029401003:1.text: As promised, I will tell you all the truth about what transpired next.
say:4:1029401003:1.source_cn: 我会依照之前的承诺，将之后发生的事情如实告知各位。

say:5:1029401004:2.text: Temesia, you don't have to speak if you don't want to...
say:5:1029401004:2.source_cn: 特弥希娅，如果你不想说的话，不需要勉强自己……

say:6:1029401005:2.text: It's okay, Atalanta. I already have a new life. I am cleansed of my sins, and there is nothing to hide about my past.
say:6:1029401005:2.source_cn: 没关系，阿塔兰忒，我已经重获新生。我的罪已被洗清，旧日...

say:7:1029401006:1.text: When I regained consciousness, I didn't have any idea what had happened, nor was I aware of anything different in my body.
say:7:1029401006:1.source_cn: 那时，我从昏迷中苏醒，并没有意识到之前发生的一切，也完...

say:8:1029401007:0.text: I believed Atalanta when she said she'd found some herbs and managed to heal me.
say:8:1029401007:0.source_cn: 我以为就像阿塔兰忒所说的那样，是她找到了草药，成功救治了我。

say:9:1029401008:1.source_cn: 好，记录完了。证人特弥希娅，你可以继续回忆了。

say:10:1029401009:1.text: Afterward, I didn't rest but returned to the Templar Knights, where I was assigned an important quest—to recover the lost Faith Stone.
say:10:1029401009:1.source_cn: 之后，我没怎么休息就回归到了圣堂骑士的队伍里，然后被分...

say:11:1029401010:0.text: ...What a fantastic coincidence! It's just like in my novels!
say:11:1029401010:0.source_cn: ……这还真是奇妙的巧合，简直就和推理小说里写的一样！

say:12:1029401011:2.text: I was surprised then, too. But thinking about it now, maybe it was fate.
say:12:1029401011:2.source_cn: 我当时也很惊讶。现在想想，这可能就是命运吧。

say:13:1029401012:1.text: I took several Templar Knights to investigate. After making some inquiries, we were able to find a witness—
say:13:1029401012:1.source_cn: 当时，我带着几位圣骑士一同调查此事。经过一番询问之后，...

say:14:1029401013:1.text: Camu, the bellman of Holistone. He saw the thief the night the Faith Stone was stolen.
say:14:1029401013:1.source_cn: 圣石镇的敲钟人卡莫，他在圣石丢失的当晚，目击到了偷窃圣...

say:15:1029401014:1.text: ...No wonder you found me so quickly. It was because of him.
say:15:1029401014:1.source_cn: ……原来你当时那么快就找到了我，是因为这家伙啊。

say:16:1029401015:1.text: Camu testified that on the night the Faith Stone was lost, he saw a woman around the square. She looked strong and had honey-colored hair.
say:16:1029401015:1.source_cn: 敲钟人卡莫的证词是，圣石丢失当晚，他在广场周边看到了一...

choice_prompt:17:1029401015.text: Camu testified that on the night the Faith Stone was lost, he saw a woman around the square. She looked strong and had honey-colored hair.
choice_prompt:17:1029401015.source_cn: 敲钟人卡莫的证词是，圣石丢失当晚，他在广场周边看到了一位拥有蜜色头发的女人，此人身手矫健。

say:18:1029401016:2.text: Seems my skills were lacking back then. I was completely exposed.
say:18:1029401016:2.source_cn: 看来我那时候业务水平还不够熟练，完全暴露了啊。

say:19:1029401017:1.text: ...Anyway, after some investigative comparison, the knights and I finally identified a suspect in the theft of the Faith Stone—Atalanta.
say:19:1029401017:1.source_cn: ……总之，经过一番比对调查之后，我和圣骑士们终于锁定了...

say:20:1029401018:1.text: That's right. Allow me to say what happened next.
say:20:1029401018:1.source_cn: 没错。之后的事情，还是由我来说吧。

say:21:1029401019:1.source_cn: 在那之后，特弥希娅很快找到了我，问我是不是偷走了圣石。...

say:22:1029401020:1.text: But you never told me where it was.
say:22:1029401020:1.source_cn: 但你并没有告诉我圣石的下落。

say:23:1029401021:2.text: Can you blame me? Knowing you, if I told the truth, you'd have cut yourself open on the spot and dug out the Faith Stone.
say:23:1029401021:2.source_cn: 那不是当然的吗？我要是说出真相，依你的性格，肯定当场就...

say:24:1029401022:1.text: And if you'd done that, wouldn't I have wasted all that effort to save you? So, even if I had to do it all over again, I still wouldn't tell you.
say:24:1029401022:1.source_cn: 你要是这么做了，我岂不是白费了那么多功夫救你？所以，即...

say:26:1029401024:1.text: Oh! So touching! Sure enough, even in the most serious detective novels, pathos is still the first element to move readers!
say:26:1029401024:1.source_cn: 呜哇，好感人！果然，即使是在最严肃的推理小说里，动人的...

say:28:1029401025:2.text: Anyway, I wouldn't tell Temesia where the Faith Stone was, no matter how many times she asked. I even thought that her stubborn nature would mean she'd turn me in to the Temple.
say:28:1029401025:2.source_cn: 总之，不管当时特弥希娅怎么问我，我都没有说出圣石的下落...

say:29:1029401026:1.text: I didn't expect her to just fall silent for a while before saying I had to leave immediately because "someone who stole the Faith Stone should not remain in Holistone".
say:29:1029401026:1.source_cn: 没想到她沉默了一段时间之后，竟然让我立马离开这里，因为...

say:30:1029401027:1.text: So that's why Temesia always looked like she bore a terrible burden... Wow, this story's getting heavy.
say:30:1029401027:1.source_cn: 因为这个，特弥希娅之前才一直看起来像是背负着什么……哇...

say:31:1029401028:1.text: What happened after Atalanta left? Didn't the Temple put out a warrant for her arrest?

say:32:1029401029:1.text: Later... It was like the whole thing just went away. The Temple didn't take things any further, and no one mentioned it again...
say:32:1029401029:1.source_cn: 后来……这件事好像就这么不了了之了。圣堂也并没有再追究...

choice_prompt:33:1029401029.text: Later... It was like the whole thing just went away. The Temple didn't take things any further, and no one mentioned it again...

say:34:1029401030:1.text: I'm truly sorry, but I don't know anything about that.
say:34:1029401030:1.source_cn: 非常抱歉，对于圣堂所拥有的那块圣石，我一无所知。

say:35:1029401031:1.text: I also tried to find any clues about that after seeing the Faith Stone in the Sun Temple. But I never got anywhere.
say:35:1029401031:1.source_cn: 之前在日神殿看到圣石之后，我也尝试追踪了这条线索，但是...

say:36:1029401032:1.text: There's definitely something shady going on, if even Temesia couldn't find anything out. My hunch tells me this means there have to be some evil forces at work behind the scenes, deliberately concealing the truth!

say:37:1029401033:1.text: There has to be some key point hidden in all this! By the way, what was the name of the witness you mentioned? The bellman?
say:37:1029401033:1.source_cn: 这里应该隐藏着推理的关键点！对了，你们之前说的那个目击...

say:38:1029401034:1.text: Camu. He's probably still in Holistone.
say:38:1029401034:1.source_cn: 敲钟人卡莫，他应该一直都在圣石镇。

say:40:1029401036:1.text: Alright! Thank you for your cooperation, Witness Temesia and Suspect Atalanta. Now we enter the next stage of our reasoning!
